content: You will be given an essay and asked about to annotate a specified part from it. Choose the argumentative role of the given sentence from list 1.opp (opponent), 2.pro (proponent). Choose only one label.

Excessive consumption of meat is unhealthy. Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive. We should thus all limit our consumption of meat rigorously. One could worry that our farmers would then run into economic difficulties. However, no serious economist has confirmed this prediction to date.
What is the argumentative role of "We should thus all limit our consumption of meat rigorously." from the given essay? choose from 1. opp 2. pro
